messages.author: Wren Haviland
messages.text: Coverage rule for a tier-1 change is the planned interval plus the two-hour watch. Dario has Sunday 00:00-06:00 on the search secondary without the cert; Yuki has 06:00-14:00 with it. Override only the uncovered hours.

messages.author: Priya Raman
messages.text: I can take Sunday 01:00-06:00 as an override; the premium is 45 an hour on a weekend night.

messages.author: Tunde Abara
messages.text: Tuesday night on the core lane is embargoed — moving it there is an exception from me, and nobody has asked. Budget is fine: 12 charged of 43, and the reclassified probe incident does not count.
